phases.label: Phase 1
phases.title: Economy & Rewards
features: Daily chest drop system — Regular / Rare / Epic
Lottie micro-feedback animations on correct answers

phases.label: Phase 2
phases.title: AI Generation & Subscription
features: AI card generation via LLM (topic / keywords prompt)
Free tier: 5 per deck + 20 per month (rate-limited)
Subscription — unlimited AI + no ads (RevenueCat entitlements)
Card quality rating (👍 / 👎 RLHF feedback loop)

phases.label: Phase 3
phases.title: Courses Platform + Focus Mode
features: Interactive lesson blocks (text, quiz, code editor, sandbox preview)
Course-linked decks (auto-created on enroll via webhook)
AI assistant: generate cards from lesson content
Freemium access — first 5 lessons free per course
Focus Mode MVP: micro-sessions, reduced daily goals (ADHD-friendly)

phases.label: Phase 4
phases.title: Social & Silent Rooms
features: Reactions on lesson blocks (aggregated, anonymous — no PII stored)
Silent Rooms via WebRTC (avatars + shared Pomodoro timer, no video by default)
Friend system with invite links (short-lived JWT tokens)
Content analytics for course creators (impressions, completion rate)

phases.label: Phase 5 – 6
phases.title: Full Focus Mode & AI Tutor
features: Full Focus Mode UI overhaul (reduced-distraction layout)
AI companion — body doubling simulation, soft nudge notifications
AI tutor — adaptive challenge generation per user mastery model
Skill map: RPG-style competency tree (DAG with unlock conditions)
Creator Economy — publish & monetize courses (revenue share)
